action_description: Added a GEMM1-only tiled FP4 dequant fast path where each CTA owns one routed slot and eight adjacent intermediate columns, stages 32-scale-column hidden bf16 blocks into shared memory once per CTA, and reuses them across per-warp x1/x2 accumulators while preserving the old warp-per-output path as fallback. Routing, GEMM2, finalization, and the Python run signature are unchanged.
